tail:

**Step 1: Calculate the chairs for the indoor tables.**
There are 9 indoor tables, and each has 10 chairs.
$$9 \text{ tables} \times 10 \text{ chairs/table} = 90 \text{ chairs}$$

**Step 2: Calculate the chairs for the outdoor tables.**
There are 11 outdoor tables, and each has 3 chairs.
$$11 \text{ tables} \times 3 \text{ chairs/table} = 33 \text{ chairs}$$

**Step 3: Add the two totals.**
$$90 \text{ chairs} + 33 \text{ chairs} = 123 \text{ chairs}$$

\boxed{123}
